title: Lecturer on Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences
bio: Samuel Lee, DMD, MDSc, FACP, is a surgically trained prosthodontist and part-time lecturer in the Department of Restorative Dentistry and Biomaterials Sciences at the Harvard School of Dental Medicine. He specializes in implant dentistry and full-mouth reconstruction. A native of Orlando, Florida, Dr. Lee earned his bachelor's degree in biomedical sciences, graduating summa cum laude from the University of South Florida Honors College. He received his Doctor of Dental Medicine (DMD) from the Harvard School of Dental Medicine and completed a three-year residency in advanced prosthodontics at the University of Connecticut School of Dental Medicine. There, he also earned a certificate in dental implant surgery and a Master of Dental Science. Dr. Lee is board certified by the American Board of Prosthodontics and holds the designation of Fellow of the American College of Prosthodontists. His clinical expertise includes crowns, bridges, veneers, and dentures.
